question: Should the official memory-lancedb plugin grow built-in BM25 plus vector hybrid retrieval now, or should advanced LanceDB hybrid/rerank behavior stay external or ClawHub-owned?
rationale: The feature is source-verifiably missing and feasible within the plugin, but it changes retrieval semantics, adds config/default surface, creates persistent FTS index lifecycle policy, and overlaps with external plugin and memory-core reranker directions.

options.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
options.body: Add memory-lancedb-owned hybrid mode with FTS indexing, explicit config/defaults, vector fallback behavior, docs, and regression tests.

options.title: Defer advanced retrieval externally
options.body: Keep official memory-lancedb vector-only and document advanced LanceDB hybrid/rerank behavior as an external package or ClawHub path.

options.title: Keep vector-only by design
options.body: Close the direction after documenting that memory-lancedb is a vector backend while memory-core and QMD own hybrid retrieval.

recommendation.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
recommendation.body: Add memory-lancedb-owned hybrid mode with FTS indexing, explicit config/defaults, vector fallback behavior, docs, and regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from memory-lancedb history and prior maintainer-side review context on this issue.
